review_notes: Twenty-two logical names from22function rows and one same-name day_count_conventions physical table alias. No views/COPY/authenticated/write objects. All22retained in denominator;12used in three focused stories. Uncovered: bs_vega,bs_theta,bs_rho and seven carry/rate-conversion functions. Current adds composed SQL examples and related agent/example metadata only. Complete package diff retained/reviewed; compute methods, registrations, schemas, entrypoint and root dependencies unchanged. Actual released interface supports current-compatible mapping, not an exact-current execution claim. The actual short release probe returns identical call prices for different call/put ConstParam values in the same vectorized SELECT. Separate materialized statements return correct call/put prices; notebook verifies parity and textbook values. bond_price returns clean quotes per100nominal independent of face size, contrary to released/current prose saying par price equals face. Face100/1000 probe retained; notebook labels actual units and cash-equivalent multiplication explicitly.
